review_BaseFileHandler: review the BaseFileHandler abstract class and its str_like flag for file I/O handler design
implement_load_from_fileobj: implement the load_from_fileobj abstract method in a subclass to parse data from a file object
implement_dump_to_fileobj: implement the dump_to_fileobj abstract method in a subclass to write data to a file object
implement_dump_to_str: implement the dump_to_str abstract method in a subclass to serialize an object to a string
use_load_from_path: use load_from_path to load and parse data from a file at a given filepath
